graduation_mechanism_provenance.finding: the established 2-layer pattern (NOT the ribbon_ride 10-filter trigger corpus -- that is a different, unrelated setup's internal trigger list): (1) filters.py GAMMA-SYNC seam -- a detect_<name>(ctx) delegator (function-local import to dodge the watchers<->filters circular import) plus a <name>_enabled(params) reader of params.json#j_<name>_enabled (default False); single-source-of-truth so backtest and live can never drift. (2) setup/scripts/setup_dispatch.py's SetupDispatcher -- the LIVE dispatch: each entry is (setup_name, enabled_flag_key, dispatch_method) in the `dispatchers` list; when the flag is True the detector runs EVERY TICK and its fired/skip_reason is logged into rec['extra_signals'] (-> core-decisions.jsonl, the same live ledger the DIRECTIONAL-GATE audit quoted); order placement is a SEPARATE, independently-gated step (_route_extra_setups -> _extra_exec_armed(params, setup_name), which requires params['extra_setup_exec_armed'][setup_name]==True; that key defaults ABSENT -> False -> _route_extra_setups always logs WATCH_NOT_ARMED and never calls _execute). double_bottom_base_quiet shipped 2026-06-28 in EXACTLY this half-armed shape (enabled=true, exec-arm key absent) per its own docstring in setup_dispatch.py -- direct, named precedent for a 'detect+log, never execute' ship.
graduation_mechanism_provenance.chosen_design: reuse this EXACT mechanism for LBFS, not a new one: j_lbfs_enabled=true (detection runs+logs every tick) with 'level_break_first_strike' left OUT of extra_setup_exec_armed (so _extra_exec_armed returns False unconditionally, WATCH_NOT_ARMED forever until a future, separate, J-scoped ratification adds the key). This satisfies the task's 'visible in triggers list, NOT yet contributing to score/gates' requirement using the codebase's own existing safety rail, proven by the SAME tests that already cover db_base_quiet/bollinger_squeeze's identical shape.

candidates.combination_policy: C1 and C2 combine into ONE combined ATM cohort (original 17 graded + any new extension signals) for the final walk-forward/ratification read; C2's contribution is reported separately (n_new_signals, its own WR) so a reader can see whether new evidence changed the picture or the verdict rests entirely on the pre-existing 2026-05-24 cohort.

walk_forward_definition.method: chronological split of the COMBINED ATM graded cohort by signal date: IS = first half (oldest signals), OOS = second half (newest signals), split at the median index (odd N -> IS gets the extra signal). This is the same chronological-split convention used elsewhere in this codebase's WF checks (not a random split -- avoids any look-ahead leakage across the split boundary).
walk_forward_definition.wf_ratio: OOS total P&L / IS total P&L, when IS P&L > 0. If IS P&L <= 0, WF is reported as 'undefined (IS non-positive)' and treated as a FAIL component (cannot compute a meaningful ratio off a non-positive base).

sub_window_stability_definition.method: split the combined ATM graded cohort into 3 roughly-equal chronological thirds (by signal order, not calendar-equal). sub_window_stable = TRUE when at most 1 of the 3 thirds is net-negative P&L (matches CLAUDE.md OP-16's 'sub_window_stable (<=1 hurt)' convention used by tonight's other studies).

pass_bar.definition_source: CLAUDE.md OP-16 Karpathy-method auto-ratify bar, the SAME bar markdown/audits/DIRECTIONAL-GATE-DEEP-RESEARCH-2026-07-15.md section 4 froze for its own 12-gate battery tonight -- reused verbatim, not invented fresh for LBFS.

components.oos_positive: OOS-half total real_fills_pnl (ATM, combined C1+C2 cohort) > 0
components.sub_window_stable: at most 1 of 3 chronological thirds net-negative (see sub_window_stability_definition)
components.anchor_no_regression: satisfied by construction this session -- see existing_evidence_at_freeze_time.anchor_day_check.consequence (shadow-only wiring cannot regress any anchor day)
components.evidence_n_ge_15_advisory: n_graded (ATM, combined cohort) >= 15 -- ADVISORY per OP-16 ('evidence_n >= 15 is advisory'), not a hard gate component

pass_bar.ship_action_is_identical_either_way: per the task's own instructions (#5 and #6), BOTH verdict labels above result in the SAME code ship this session: the setup_dispatch.py + params.json shadow-logged wiring in graduation_mechanism_provenance.chosen_design. The pass/fail verdict changes ONLY the honesty label attached to the ship (RATIFIED-shadow vs UNRATIFIED-but-shipped-as-telemetry), never the code.
